law_name: Personal Data Protection Act No. 9 of 2022 (PDPA)
key_requirements: Lawful & transparent processing, data protection officers, breach reporting, impact assessments
retention_period: s.9 limit on retention period: identifiable data kept only as long as necessary for purposes; archiving/research exceptions (Part I not yet in force)
enforcement_authority: Data Protection Authority of Sri Lanka
penalties_range: Up to LKR 10M per non-compliance (doubled for repeats)
exemptions: Personal or household use; national security
notes: Phased: DPA set up 2023; Parts I & III start 2027-01-01; penalties (Part VII) not yet in force
